findings: ZIP 78119 (Kenedy) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.

Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78119 (Kenedy) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
